About this fundraiser

Why Kansas City needs this — right now

Families across KC are hitting a breaking point. Food drives are up, pantry volunteers are showing up, but critical gaps are still going completely unmet. We’re hearing the same stories again and again: expired canned goods, spoiled produce, no soft foods for unhoused neighbors, and schools struggling to keep basic snacks on hand.

What local partners are seeing

  • Expired cans and spoiled produce at some pickups
  • Little to no dairy, meat, butter, or formula available
  • No soft foods like bananas, yogurt, or oatmeal for neighbors without teeth
  • School snack and kid-friendly food supplies running dry
  • Pantries stretched beyond capacity trying to meet rising demand
Kansas City is helping — but the need is outpacing the system. Rogue Round Table is stepping in with something flexible: cash that can be used exactly where the gaps are this week.

How your donation works

  1. Cash only. Partners like Harvesters can stretch every donated dollar further than most grocery trips.
  2. Funds stay in Kansas City. Every dollar supports KC families and KC organizations.
  3. You get the album free. Every donor receives the full We Want a Chiefs Christmas album as a thank-you.

The music

What’s on the We Want a Chiefs Christmas album?

This is a full KC-style holiday project — built with AI tools, live vocals, and a lot of late-night Chiefs fandom. From front-porch country and gospel-trap to kids’ club mixes and a cinematic finale, there’s a track for every kind of Kingdom Christmas.
